title: Construction Loans Rate Sheet: Spreads, Floors and Interest Billing Terms
content:
Construction Loans are priced over the Association Variable Base Rate during construction. This rate sheet sets, for each product, the spread in percentage points, the lowest construction-period rate, and the terms on which construction interest is counted, billed, due and applied.

## Construction-period pricing

| Product | Spread over the Association Variable Base Rate (percentage points) | Lowest construction-period rate (annual %) |
|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 1.0 | 6.0 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 0.5 | 5.75 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 0.75 | 5.75 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 0.75 | 5.75 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 0.5 | 5.5 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 0.5 | 5.5 |

## Interest terms during construction

| Product | Interest only during construction | Day-count convention | Billing | Interest due day | Interest reserve line may pay the bill | Undesignated remittance applied to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | No | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | Yes | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | Yes | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | No | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | Yes | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | Yes | Actual days over a 365-day year | Monthly | 10th | Yes | fees, then interest, then principal |

## Definitions

- **Rate spread** — Percentage points over the Association Variable Base Rate during construction.
- **Rate floor** — Lowest construction-period rate, annual %.
- **Day-count basis** — Interest day-count convention.
- **Interest billing** — When construction interest is billed.
- **Interest due day** — Day of the month construction interest is due, for the prior calendar month.
- **Interest only** — Boolean; whether only interest is due during construction.
- **Interest reserve allowed** — Boolean; whether construction interest may be paid from an interest reserve line of the budget.
- **Payment application order** — Order in which an undesignated remittance is applied.

## Reading the sheet

- The widest spread, 1.0 percentage point, and the highest floor, 6.0 percent, belong to the Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan; the Farm Building and Livestock Facility Construction Loans carry a 0.5 point spread and a 5.5 percent floor.
- On every product, interest for a calendar month is due on the 10th day of the following month.
- An interest reserve line may pay the bill on the Single-Close and Two-Close Home Construction Loans and on the Farm Building and Livestock Facility Construction Loans; it may not on the Owner-Builder or Post-Frame Home Construction Loan.
